user_query: Which specific classes are instantiated and returned by the WorkerFactory.CreateWorkers() method?

response.answer: The WorkerFactory.CreateWorkers() method instantiates and returns three specific worker classes: WorkerA, WorkerB, and WorkerC. This method is a public static factory method located in HelloWorldApp/WorkerFactory.cs that takes an INotifier parameter and returns an IEnumerable<IWorker>. The implementation creates a new List<IWorker> collection containing instances of all three worker classes: 'new WorkerA(notifier)', 'new WorkerB(notifier)', and 'new WorkerC(notifier)'. Each worker class is instantiated using the 'new' keyword and their constructors all accept the same INotifier parameter. The method implements a covariant return pattern by declaring IEnumerable<IWorker> as the return type while actually returning the more specific List<IWorker> concrete collection. All three worker classes (WorkerA, WorkerB, WorkerC) are public classes that implement the IWorker interface, which defines a Process() method.
